LanguageData.WFL_Works_MasonBonus: Construction speed rises 15% and construction success 10%. Experience comes from building.
LanguageData.WFL_Works_CarpenterBonus: Smoothing speed rises 15% and construction success 10%. Experience comes from building and smoothing.
LanguageData.WFL_Works_EngineerBonus: Construction speed rises 15% and success at fixing broken-down buildings 15%. Experience comes from building and repair.
LanguageData.WFL_Works_ProspectorBonus: Mining speed rises 15%. Experience comes from mining.
LanguageData.WFL_Works_QuarrymanBonus: Mining speed rises 20%. Experience comes from mining.
LanguageData.WFL_Works_TunnellerBonus: Mining speed rises 10%. Experience comes from mining.
LanguageData.WFL_Works_PlacesHelp: Places are recognised from what is in them, never painted. A Workshop is an enclosed room with at least two work benches and no bed; building, repairing and smoothing in one earns a quarter more experience. A Mine is a dug-out room of at least six cells, not outdoors, most of it under thick mountain roof; digging in or beside one earns a quarter more.
